info.name: Seer Apprentice
info.description: The Seer Apprentice background from Arcana Unleashed.

ul.li: Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Navigator's Tools, 8 Candles, Ink, Ink Pen, Parchment (9 sheets), Pouch, Tinderbox, Traveler's Clothes, 11 GP; or (B) 50 GP

description.p: As an apprentice among the Seers of Sea and Sky, you learned to interpret minor omens from the clouds above and the fathoms below. The organization's rich network of libraries furthered your education, and you now travel across the world, imparting advice and aid to others.

setters.set: Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, Arcane Omens Feat, History and Insight Skills, Navigator's Tools
